# Pixel sizes, as tmux's (COMPATIBILITY.md §11): a pane's TIOCGWINSZ holds its size in pixels,
# from a 16×32 cell, or from the attached terminal's own cell (its pixels over its size).
size 80x24
run new-session -d -s a -x 80 -y 24 'faketui -mode resize'
waittext %0 'pixels) READY'
run capture-pane -p -t a
# A terminal with 10×20 pixel cells: the window takes its cell.
client c 100x30 10x20
waittext %0 'size: 100x29'
run capture-pane -p -t a
resize c 120x40
waittext %0 'size: 120x39'
run capture-pane -p -t a
run kill-server
